summary: In tribal democratic society, defence was managed by the whole armed community. As class divisions widened, ruling elites replaced this with a professional armed police and military under their control.
context: Engels identifies the birth of the state machine. The state does not represent the whole community; it creates specialized bodies of armed men (police, armed forces, prisons) to enforce property rights and suppress rebellions.
